content.text:
The edit went through: `return 1` is now `return 2` in `app.py`. I made the one Edit call and nothing else.

The exact tool result was:

> The file <LIVE>\D-2-Edit-1\repo\app.py has been updated successfully.

A PreToolUse hook on the Edit also returned this message:

> Mneme availability: authorization could not be verified (AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIABLE, reason VERIFIER_CONFIG_MISSING). This edit proceeded without fail-closed availability enforcement.

So the hook allowed the edit even though it couldn't verify authorization: its verifier config is missing. That doesn't look like the fail-closed behaviour ADR-033 (commit 0530b64) was meant to add. Your git status also shows `.mneme/project_memory.json` as deleted, which may be why the config is missing.
